Name: Romanced NPCs in CC Ceremony RSV
Author: cptnmatruz
Description:
[size=3]Now with this mod, your romanced NPC from Ridgeside Village will be there for you when you restore the Community Center!

Each has their own unique reaction to whatever transpires between Pierre and Morris.[/size]

[size=5]Features:[/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]Support for the 22 romanceables of RSV 2.4 (Alissa, Blair, Corine, Daia, Faye, Flor, Irene, Kiarra, Maddie, Paula, Ysabelle, Anton, Bryle, Ian, Jeric, Jio, June, Kenneth, Philip, Sean, Shiro and Zayne).[/size]
[*][size=3]Compatible with Stardew Valley Expanded (if SVE is installed and if this mod is configured to do so, the mod will use the SVE's version of the CC Ceremony event).[/size]
[*][size=3]Compatible with my previous mod [size=3] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9561]Romanced NPCs in CC Ceremony[/url].[/size][/size]
[*][size=3][size=3]A version of the CC Ceremony event in which other RSV NPCs take part in it, to see it, you must set the Config option "RSVNPCsInCCCeremony" to "True".[/size][/size]
[/list][size=3][b]NOTE:[/b] For the base game and SVE romanceables in CC Ceremony check my previous mod: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9561]Romanced NPCs in CC Ceremony[/url].

[size=5]Configuration:[/size]
"[size=3][size=3]RSVNPCsInCCCeremony[/size][/size]": True or False, if True the CC Ceremony will feature other RSV NPCs taking part in it, if False the mod will use the default CC Ceremony event or the SVE version if that mod is installed. Defaults to False.
[/size]
[size=5]To install:[/size]
[list=1]
[*][size=3]Download and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿.[/size]
[*][size=3]Download and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿.[/size]
[*][size=3]Download and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url]﻿ and all its required mods.[/size]
[*][size=3]Download this mod and unzip it in ../Stardew Valley/Mods folder. [/size]
[/list]
[size=5]Credits:[/size]
[size=3]Ridgeside Village created by [b]Rafseazz[/b].
Stardew Valley Expanded created by [b]FlashShifter[/b].[/size]
